SELECT
  id,
  topic,
  platform,
  style,
  duration_seconds,
  language,
  target_audience,
  status,
  created_at,
  updated_at
FROM video_topics
WHERE status = 'IDEA'
ORDER BY created_at ASC
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE video_topics
SET status = 'GENERATING_SCRIPT', error = NULL
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING *;

UPDATE video_topics
SET
  title = $1,
  hook = $2,
  script = $3,
  cover_text = $4,
  template_type = $5,
  hashtags = $6::jsonb,
  shots_json = $7::jsonb,
  risk_check = $8::jsonb,
  status = 'SCRIPT_READY',
  error = NULL
WHERE id = $9
RETURNING *;

parameters.query:
-- 原子领取 1 条 SCRIPT_READY 任务，避免多个工作流同时处理同一条。
-- 领取后状态改为 MEDIA_READY：在本方案里表示“已进入素材/渲染阶段”。

WITH picked AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM video_topics
  WHERE status = 'SCRIPT_READY'
  ORDER BY updated_at ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
UPDATE video_topics AS v
SET
  status = 'MEDIA_READY',
  error = NULL,
  updated_at = NOW()
FROM picked
WHERE v.id = picked.id
RETURNING
  v.id::text AS id,
  v.topic,
  v.platform,
  v.style,
  v.duration_seconds,
  v.language,
  v.target_audience,
  v.title,
  v.hook,
  v.script,
  v.cover_text,
  v.hashtags,
  v.shots_json,
  v.risk_check,
  v.status,
  v.created_at,
  v.updated_at;

-- Worker 成功生成视频后，把任务推进到 NEED_REVIEW。
-- n8n Postgres 节点建议使用参数化查询。
-- 参数顺序：
-- $1 = cover_path
-- $2 = video_path
-- $3 = render_result JSON 字符串
-- $4 = id

UPDATE video_topics
SET
  cover_path = $1,
  video_path = $2,
  risk_check = COALESCE(risk_check, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('render_result', $3::jsonb),
  status = 'NEED_REVIEW',
  error = NULL,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $4::uuid
RETURNING
  id::text AS id,
  topic,
  title,
  cover_path,
  video_path,
  status,
  updated_at;

parameters.query:
-- 08_claim_one_script_ready_for_enhanced.sql
-- 原子领取 1 条 SCRIPT_READY 任务，并立刻标记为 RENDERING。
-- 使用 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED，后面并发跑多个 worker 时也不容易重复领取。

WITH picked AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM video_topics
  WHERE status = 'SCRIPT_READY'
  ORDER BY created_at ASC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE video_topics AS vt
SET
  status = 'RENDERING',
  render_started_at = NOW(),
  updated_at = NOW(),
  error = NULL
FROM picked
WHERE vt.id = picked.id
RETURNING vt.*;

-- 09_update_need_review_enhanced.sql
-- video-worker 成功返回后，把最终视频与中间文件 manifest 回写数据库。
-- 在 n8n Postgres 节点里建议使用 Query Parameters：
-- $1 = video_path
-- $2 = cover_path
-- $3 = subtitle_path
-- $4 = clips_json，字符串化 JSON
-- $5 = render_manifest，字符串化 JSON
-- $6 = task_id

UPDATE video_topics
SET
  status = 'NEED_REVIEW',
  video_path = $1,
  cover_path = $2,
  subtitle_path = $3,
  clips_json = $4::jsonb,
  render_manifest = $5::jsonb,
  render_finished_at = NOW(),
  updated_at = NOW(),
  error = NULL
WHERE id = $6
RETURNING id, status, video_path, cover_path, subtitle_path, updated_at;
